# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: GCC 1970 — event hooks.
# COLDWAR GCC | generated by tools/gcc_1970/compile.py
on_actions = {
	on_daily = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
		}
	}

	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
			KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
			BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
			QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
			OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
			UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
		}
	}

	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
		}
	}

	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_tick = yes }
		}
	}

	on_puppet = {
		effect = {
			ROOT = {
				if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	on_release_as_puppet = {
		effect = {
			ROOT = {
				if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	on_subject_free = {
		effect = {
			ROOT = {
				if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	on_release_as_free = {
		effect = {
			ROOT = {
				if = { limit = { COLDWAR_GCC_host = yes } COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes }
			}
		}
	}
}
